unknown_policy: Omit unsupported tags; leave unknown identity/year null. New labels require taxonomy revision.

industry.definition: Client business sector; not the technology vendor sector.

function.definition: Business function served by the solution.

technology.definition: Technology explicitly established by the selected pages.

ai_use_case.definition: Specific AI task; do not infer AI from ordinary automation.

outcome_type.definition: Type of publisher-reported benefit, not independent verification.

brand_context.definition: Explicit premium/luxury context or brand constraints. Do not treat these as interchangeable.

engagement_type.definition: Engagement maturity when explicit; unknown if absent.

label_notes.premium: High-end product positioning; not automatically luxury or ultra-luxury.
label_notes.brand_guidelines: Explicit on-brand assets or brand requirements; not evidence of luxury.
label_notes.artificial_intelligence: AI is explicit but no specific generative model/type established.
label_notes.marketing_content_generation: Marketing asset creation; separate from medical information or service summaries.
label_notes.workplace_assistant: General workplace productivity; not automatically software engineering.
